programme.title: Evil Rises
programme.desc: While recovering from surgery, Jacinda Rearick notices orbs in photos, believing them to be her late parents. But when her son sees a dark entity and shadowy tentacles attack her, she realizes something sinister has invaded their home. As the entity grows more violent, Jacinda turns to local investigators, desperate to rid her house of the encroaching evil.

programme.title: Ghost Confessions
programme.desc: The Sherman family's dream life turns into a nightmare when 17-year-old Macy is targeted by a terrifying entity. As her mother and sister experience paranormal activity, their skeptical father remains unconvinced-until he hears an unseen presence speak. With the spirit refusing to leave, the desperate family turns to experts for help before it's too late.

programme.title: Demons Never Die
programme.desc: After moving to the suburbs, Bill and Amanda Toler dismiss eerie noises-until Bill is scratched and Amanda sees an inhuman face. Paranormal investigators uncover a portal in their home and a demon that followed Bill from his job at a penitentiary. In a race against time, they must close the portal and banish the entity before it destroys the family.

programme.title: House of Sorrows
programme.desc: Darrin and Jamie Shriver move into a home where four people died of CO poisoning. Strange sounds and ghostly sightings soon turn sinister-Darrin and their dog are attacked. Paranormal investigators cleanse the home, but Darrin unknowingly invites dark forces back, putting his wife and newborn in grave danger. Can they escape the house's tragic fate?

programme.title: Buried Secrets
programme.desc: Strange occurrences in Charles Gonzales' home awaken memories of past paranormal events tied to his uncle's unsolved murder. Seeking answers, he contacts psychic Desiree Page, who warns of a deadly family curse. When a vengeful spirit attacks Charles and his girlfriend, he must confront childhood memories and uncover hidden truths before the entity traps him forever.

programme.title: Love Curse
programme.desc: For years, a dark force stalks Lee Moore in his nightmares. After he and his bride Claire move into their first home, the entity emerges, attacking Claire while she's pregnant. A ghost hunter confirms it's a demon, and experts cleanse the home. But when the hunter returns for an uninvited ritual, Lee falls mysteriously ill. Can demonologists save him before the entity claims his soul?

programme.title: Dark Wrath
programme.desc: Cindy's recurring nightmares of a dark, angry figure intensify as she moves her family to an old house in her rural hometown. Assuming it's just stress, she pushes forward, but soon, her dreams become reality. Her daughters fear their room, and an eerie presence lurks in the shadows. When the entity physically attacks her, Cindy must summon her courage to fight the evil before it harms her family.

programme.title: Demon's Lair
programme.desc: The Cranmer family believes their historic Pittsburgh home is haunted by a harmless ghost-until the activity turns violent. Seeking help from the Catholic Church, they uncover a demon and the home's dark past. As attacks escalate and walls ooze a blood-like substance, they refuse to flee, facing a terrifying battle that culminates in a desperate exorcism.

programme.title: Monster in the Apartment
programme.desc: Morgan Knudson and her friend Bob move into a downtown Edmonton flat, only to discover a dark spirit lurking. While Bob, battling cancer and loneliness, sees a harmless ghostly boy, Morgan senses something sinister. When the entity violently attacks her, she seeks a demonologist who reveals the truth-the spirit is trying to possess Bob, and Morgan must act before it claims his soul.

programme.title: The Awakening
programme.desc: Randy and Marcy, both in law enforcement, face mounting stress when their son is deployed overseas. Marcy's overwhelming fear awakens a dormant spirit that feeds on her anxiety, growing dangerously powerful. As the presence tightens its grip, Marcy must stay calm and find a way to banish the evil force before it drives her to the brink.

programme.title: Gateway To Evil
programme.desc: Devastated by a friend's murder, Julisa holds a séance to communicate one last time--and unwittingly invites a dark spirit into her home...and her life. Julisa and her mother believe that she has re-ignited the evil that plagued her mother years ago.

programme.title: The Possessed
programme.desc: Paranormal investigators risk their own safety to protect others. Mary Vogel, a spiritual counselor, faces a force that shakes her faith. Nightmares consume her, unseen entities attack, and even church feels sinister. A voice whispers, 'Your God can't help you now.' Her mentor, John Zaffis, realizes the truth-Mary is possessed, and only an exorcism can save her soul.

programme.title: Ghost Protector
programme.desc: A mother and daughter both believe their house is haunted. But while the mother believes it's the spirit of her murdered boyfriend, her daughter believes it's much darker. After paranormal experts investigate they uncover an epic battle between good and evil.

programme.title: The Uninvited
programme.desc: Lynn and Jason Ryder purchase a historic Connecticut restaurant, only to be overwhelmed by forces of evil when employees and patrons are attacked. Investigators, mediums and clairvoyants are called in to rid the restaurant of its demonic past.

programme.title: Curse of the Mummy
programme.desc: After a chilling encounter at an Egyptian exhibit, Caleb Weaver is haunted by a relentless entity. Years of torment force him to flee, but when he returns home, the dark force reawakens-stronger than ever. Now, it seeks to possess him and threatens those he loves. With time running out, Caleb turns to a deliverance minister for a final battle against the ancient evil seeking his soul.

programme.title: Mother's Terror
programme.desc: After Jeanette's firefighter husband dies, she moves her daughters to a Long Island hamlet for a fresh start. But eerie discoveries and violent paranormal attacks turn their refuge into a nightmare. Determined to fight back, Jeanette enlists a psychic to uncover the home's dark past and a deliverance minister to confront the relentless evil threatening her family's safety.

programme.title: Spellbound
programme.desc: Sandra Waldron is fascinated by the supernatural, but her son Gene wants no part of it. When they learn their home is haunted, Sandra dives deeper into the paranormal, eventually embracing Wicca. Seeking good fortune, she unknowingly opens a portal to evil. With Gene gone in the military, Sandra must now battle the dark force she unleashed before it consumes her entirely.

programme.title: Echoes of the Past
programme.desc: Libby and Sean Johnson renovate a Vermont home, unaware of its tragic past. Soon, eerie noises fill the night, and their daughter speaks of visiting 'fairies.' As they uncover the home's dark history, ghostly activity escalates to physical attacks. Desperate for answers, Libby turns to paranormal investigators, hoping they can rid the house of restless spirits before it's too late.

programme.title: Echoes from the Grave
programme.desc: Ron and Nancy believe their historic Baltimore home is perfect. But the seller warns, 'I hope you're good fighters.' At first, they battle faulty wiring and strange plumbing issues. Then, objects move on their own, and Nancy dreams of an old woman laughing as their house burns. As the haunting increases, they realize their home is a gateway between life and death-and someone tried to seal it shut.

programme.title: The Calling
programme.desc: Rebecca's new marriage to Daniel seems perfect, but she hides a lifelong secret-she can see and hear spirits. She has always blocked them out, but when a persistent ghost refuses to be ignored, she can no longer run. Forced to confront the entity, Rebecca must trust Daniel and enlist his help to uncover the truth before it threatens their new life together.

programme.title: The Shadowman
programme.desc: As kids, Tim and Tom Yancey love playing in the Florida woods-until a menacing presence begins watching them. When it invades their bedroom, terror traps them in their own home. With no help in sight, the nightmare follows Tim into adulthood. Decades later, he returns to confront the demon that stole his childhood, determined to reclaim his life once and for all.

programme.title: The Presence
programme.desc: Evil thrives on deception, slowly eroding faith and family bonds. Sarah Miller senses something supernatural in her home, terrifying her children and making her question reality. Her boyfriend's skepticism deepens the divide as a demonic force tightens its grip. A religious demonologist identifies a diabolical infestation and prepares a ritual to expel the entity before it destroys them.

programme.title: The Exorcism of Cindy Sauer
programme.desc: Deadly Attachment Georgia single Mom Cindy Sauer tries to get over the sudden death of her husband when dark shadows and nightmares convince her that a demon is haunting her and her family. Cindy turns to a Pastor to exorcise the entity before it drives them literally insane.

programme.title: A Haunting in Florida
programme.desc: Some places are charged with psychic energy, still traveled by spirits that haven't passed on. Edd and Beth's new home seems ideal, but soon they see a transparent man, a misty old woman, and a growing dark cloud. As supernatural forces intensify, a paranormal investigator confirms their fears. Their home is a portal, filled with enough negative energy to erupt into something terrifying.

programme.title: Deaths Door
programme.desc: Victoria Dane of New Mexico awakens from a near-­death experience to discover she is being attacked by a dark, demonic entity. With the help of investigators, she soon realizes she has opened a door to a paranormal world that may never be shut.

programme.title: When the Lights Go Out
programme.desc: After newlyweds Brooke and Dominic Ardolino experience strange paranormal events in their home, they call in investigators who uncover two spirits - one is trying to warn them while the other is dangerous.

programme.title: Living Nightmare
programme.desc: After marrying Stephen, Angela's childhood nightmares return-only now, the old hag from her dreams appears in waking life. She dismisses it as anxiety until the entity terrorizes her daughter and briefly possesses her son. Realizing the threat is real, Angela, at Stephen's urging, turns to paranormal investigators to fight the relentless evil before it destroys their family.

programme.title: Stalked by Evil
programme.desc: Judy McCarthy hopes for a fresh start in Texas, but a shadowy presence emerges in their home. It fixates on her teenage daughter, Caressa, tormenting her each night. As the entity grows stronger, Judy fights to protect her family. When she uncovers the home's violent past, she realizes the spirit is intent on keeping Caressa trapped-and she must act before it's too late.

programme.title: Hell House
programme.desc: In this world, evil lurks in both shadows and unassuming places. It deceives and destroys. When Bonnie's family buys a 19th-century Connecticut farmhouse, they feel watched. After unseen entities attack her children, they seek out psychic investigators. As events grow violent, Bonnie forms a psychic link to the past, and investigators witness the haunting escalate from obsession to possession.

programme.title: House of the Dead
programme.desc: Children often feel powerless in the face of the adult world. In Glen Burnie, Maryland, 10-year-old Billy Bean's life is already in crisis. He and his sister are attacked at night-pinned to their beds by unseen forces. Billy senses an evil presence destroying his family. As the attacks worsen, he fights to uncover the dark secrets of the house on Little Road before he loses everything.

programme.title: The Attic
programme.desc: Some believe knowledge comes from reason, others from intuition. When Selena moves into an old Michigan house, she senses danger. The attic makes her dizzy, the kitchen feels watched, and photos reveal ghostly faces. With proof of a haunting, she and her sister seek a psychic's help. He confirms the worst-the house is a place of suffering, trapping both the living and the dead.

programme.title: The Unleashed
programme.desc: Some Native American myths tell of supernatural creatures guarding the dead. Early explorers spoke of werewolves and the Wendigo. When Randy discovers a Native American skeleton beneath his home, he recites an incantation, hoping to make contact. Soon, a cold, growling monster appears, attacking his loved ones. The spirits don't want the house-they want him, and they won't let go.

programme.title: Darkness Follows
programme.desc: Some bonds can't be broken-like a mother's love or a killer's grip on his victim. Al, Kellie, and her daughter Hailey move into a Montreal townhouse, aware of its tragic past. A teen girl, evicted with her mother, took her own life. But death wasn't the end. Haunting audio recordings reveal she has returned-with a follower. As Al obsesses over a past murder, Kellie fears a killer still lurks.

programme.title: Shape of Evil
programme.desc: Jay Yaple moves his family into a fixer-upper in Enfield, CT, unaware of its dark history. Unexplained events soon turn into terrifying attacks, and Jay realizes a malevolent entity is targeting them. Anyone who tries to help is driven away by the demon. Trapped and desperate, the family turns to an exorcist as their last hope-but will it be enough to break the entity's hold?

programme.title: Phantom Room
programme.desc: Shari and Erol's new California home seems perfect-until they discover a hidden room in the garage. Strange events follow, but while Shari believes the house is haunted, Erol remains skeptical. When the ghost becomes violent, Shari seeks help from a psychic, who uncovers an angry spirit determined to drive them out. Can they reclaim their home before the ghost tears their family apart?

programme.title: Conjuring Evil

What starts as small disturbances escalates into violent attacks, even hospitalizing Cindy's mother. A skeptic, Harold investigates and uncovers the terrifying truth. With their family in danger, they call in experts to reclaim their home.

programme.title: Fear Feeders
programme.desc: After buying a home near Fort Wayne, Al Gonzalez hears strange noises and sees shadows but keeps quiet, fearing no one will believe him. When entities torment him day and night-mimicking a deceased loved one-he seeks help. Investigators confirm the house is infested with dangerous spirits, and Al realizes he may not be their first victim.

programme.title: Child's Play
programme.desc: Chris and Roseann Cupit find comfort in the spirit of Chris' late grandmother watching over their Arkansas home. But her presence is a warning-a relentless demon has targeted their daughter, tormenting her with night terrors and attacks. Desperate, they seek help from their pastor, but he refuses. Turning to a paranormal team and a demonologist, they prepare for a battle to save their family.

programme.title: Hidden Terror

A late-night encounter with an invisible force convinces him they are haunted. He sets up surveillance, watching and waiting. What he captures shakes him to the core-are ghosts real, or is he losing his mind?

When an unseen force attacks him, Jeanette seeks help from a voodoo priest and paranormal expert John Zaffis. As malevolent energy threatens her family, Jeanette must confront the spirits' wrath before their home becomes a place of irreversible terror.

programme.title: The Diabolical

Her daughter Julie, unable to walk or talk, interacts with unseen forces. Marie wonders if they're angels-until she comes face to face with a demon. A Ouija board session turns their home into a portal for darkness, proving that evil can lurk in the most ordinary places.

Even the church's blessing fails, forcing the family to flee their dream home before it destroys them.

programme.desc: Toki tries to turn the life of his rock-and-roll clown friend, Dr. Rockzo, around by investing Dethklok's vacation fund. Everything goes smoothly until the media peers into Rockzo's past and discovers the clown's darkest secret.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: While Dethklok's manager, Charles Offdensen, is absent cleaning up hundreds of problems caused by the band, Dethklok double books a gig--between Syria and Israel on the same day.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Despite his bandmates' warnings, Nathan begins seriously dating one of his fans. But as the evidence of her past piles up, to prove her innocence, he follows her to the most brutal place on earth: Klokikon - the annual Dethklok fan convention filled with cosplay geeks and homosexual fan art. Meanwhile, the rest of the band starts smoking after Murderface lands the cover of Smokaroonie Aficionado.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After Dethklok is accused of being racist at a huge press conference, they combat the charges by opening an Urban Youth Dethcenter. Meanwhile, Toki, after being left behind, starts a special club that promotes equality and love but excludes Murderface because he doesn't have the right look.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: With their new album finally shipping, Dethklok plans their post-release traditions of vacationing, goofing off, palling around, and prank calls. Nathan, however, can't shake the feeling that something is wrong with the record... After being humiliated by Murderface's prank calls, Skwisgaar and Toki swear revenge.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok heads to Tomahawk, Wisconsin to open a Dethfair in hopes that it will stimulate the economy they destroyed. Pickles uses this time at home to reconnect with his disapproving mother who tells him that she won't respect him until he gets a real job. Pickles decides to hang up his drumsticks and goes into an even more brutal profession: he becomes a realtor.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Tired of taking verbal abuse from his bandmate, Toki writes a tell-all book called Skwisgaar Is Ams Dick and takes over as Dethklok's lead guitarist. But can Toki handle the spotlight? Meanwhile, Nathan buys a new favorite toy for the band: a defibrillator.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After spending all their time with sluts and squandering the budget on their new record, Dethklok is shocked to find they've been assigned a new producer: A WOMAN. She sends them on a pre-writing vacation that turns out to be a brutal trip to a third world country where they're mistaken as women and captured as sex slaves.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: In an effort to make friends, Toki goes to Rockaroonie Fantasy Camp - a weekend getaway to rub elbows with rock and roll royalty (but he attends as a camper.) Instead of meeting friends, he is bullied by other campers and has no one to turn to but celebrity counselor, Magnus Hammersmith; ex-Dethklok guitarist with a troubled past. With Toki - the diabetic scaredy cat - out of Mordhaus, Skwisgaar and Murderface act out and over do it with candy and scary movies.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After Murderface is announced as the recipient of this year's Most Brutal Looking Musician Award, he travels to Mexico to get the best and cheapest plastic surgery possible. Meanwhile, the rest of Dethklok deal with the brutality of aging and letting themselves go.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok returns to the water to record in their new Dethsub but, plagued with the lack of women, carpel tunnel sets in from excessive masturbation. The band regresses to an animal mindset. Pickles and Nathan spend their energy crossing the workplace relationship line and competing for the only woman on the sub: their producer.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: As Dethklok hosts the most important dinner of their career, the divvying of album credits, over tagging on social networking sites, and fights over a girl come to head. Can CFO keep their issues in check? Will the record executives forgive them for the past year of mistakes? Or will it be a total, brutal disaster?

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: While the world awaits the final Dethklok performance, members of the band prepare for their post-Dethklok careers. Pickles starts a winery for the most alcoholic wine ever, Nathan and Swkisgaar look for a brand new sound that doesn't suck, and Toki works with Murderface on his campaign for congressman. Meanwhile, Salacia takes Dethklok's weakness as the opportune time to strike!

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok is notified of a looming secret that's been around for hundreds of years: the secret of the Metalocalypse. Before they can contemplate what this means, however, Nathan must give a eulogy and do the most brutal thing he has ever done: get in touch with his emotions.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.sub-title: METALOCALYPSE: the DOOMSTAR REQUIEM A KLOK OPERA
programme.desc: Will Dethklok find their lost bandmate Toki Wartooth? Find out in this hour long Rock Opera special featuring a 50 piece orchestra and special guests Mark Hamill, Malcolm McDowell, and Cannibal Corpse's George "Corpsegrinder" Fisher.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After performing a coffee jingle in the farthest reaches of the Arctic Circle to a sold-out crowd, Dethklok witnesses their French chef being chopped to pieces by the blade of their helicopter restaurant. The bad news is that Dethklok is now faced with the daunting task of cooking dinner themselves.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: In an attempt to make their next album the most brutal ever, Dethklok commissions a Russian nuclear submarine to record deep in the Nordic waters. Underwater, the band copes with seasickness, whale and radar pings infecting their tracks, and loss of food and oxygen.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: The band plays a song that unintentionally wakes a deadly Nordic Forest Troll. Dethklok doesn't care until they learn that the Troll is knocking out all DSL lines, making their Internet really slow. Dethklok must write the world's first Death Metal Lullaby to put the demonic beast back to sleep.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: In a legendary bad move, Dethklok decides to do standup comedy. Pickles remains traumatized by a heckler while the rest of Dethklok learns that comedy is all about embracing the hate. Dethklok finds that they are very much naturals at this. The physical comedy routine they work out really kills.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Uncomfortable and embarrassed, Dethklok painfully endures while their parents are in town for a visit. The guys are at first pissed and doubtful when their parents announce the release of their "Parents of Dethklok" album, but are then impressed by the depth of their parents' anger.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Pickles reunites with his old hair band, "Snakes 'N' Barrels", which has the rest of Dethklok worried that their drummer may leave them. When the ten-years-sober "Snakes 'N' Barrels" are given experimental psychotropic drugs before their performance, the result is something beyond brutal.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok has opened up their home for their annual Dethfan Day. Dethklok continues with their "normal" everyday activities (like liver transplant surgery and scrubbing toilets) while fans are ushered around the house, guided by an animated skull and a maze of velvet rope. Dethklok finds themselves in a sticky situation when two Internet geeks threaten to bring down Dethklok with their advanced Photoshopping skills.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: In a last-ditch scramble for tax breaks, Dethklok agrees to host an event with the London Philharmonic, but only under one condition: Dethklok gets to produce their own kind of laser light show. They've also taken in a distempered fat kid they found, and must juggle the responsibilities of parenting while upholding their charitable agreement.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Skwisgaar is to host the Skwisgaar Skwigelf Advanced Hand Finger Wizard Master Class Pay Per View Event, to promote the sales of a new guitar line, which includes the Skwisarmyatar, and the Antfarmatar.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok has an end of the quarter employee evaluation to find out who's been embezzling from the company. The patronizing evaluation heads off with a pep talk and a corporate video that will have audiences and Dethfans alike vying for a spot on the Dethklok payroll.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Plagued by his stupidity, Nathan Explosion embarks on the dicey journey of earning his GED.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Depressed, Dethklok is whisked away to the Mississippi Delta to "discover" the Blues.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Murderface searches for a religion after a near-death experience leaves him longing for greater meaning. He samples everything from Christianity to Satanism before finding his true church.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Toki tries to compensate for his adorable charm by over-brutalizing his intentions and actions.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: The Tribunal commissions Dr. Rockzo, The Rock N Roll Clown, to gather information on Dethklok. Dr. Rockzo and Toki's sudden friendship has the rest of Dethklok uneasy.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok is asked to host the American Pornography Awards, but Nathan's controlling girlfriend puts a damper on the situation for the whole band.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: When Dethklok is given a Carte Blanche development deal, the future of silver screen entertainment rests in their hands.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: In this first season finale, the Metalocalypse creeps closer to fulfillment when Dethklok executes their most brutal performance to date, and the Tribunal finally makes their move.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Since Dethklok's withdrawal from the public following the purported Dethwater Live "fan attack", the world economy teeters on the brink of disaster. Dethklok is finally lured back into the outside world with their protective "pelvic-thrust mace belts" to be a part of the world's largest public execution of criminals in recorded history.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Toki Wartooth is fed up playing in the shadow of Skwisgaar's lead guitar. Under the tutelage of a crusty old guitar master, Toki learns that the heart, too, has strings.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: The wounded, the scared, and the disfigured unite. Meanwhile, an oblivious Dethklok spends their studio time recording onto the purest of all analog formats: water.

programme.desc: The RC writers wonder what would happen if the alien from Alien was a different alien? Bert from Sesame Street gets a new roommate, we see what The Terminator would have been like as a step-dad, and Papa Smurf sees what goes on behind the scenes in Undercover Smurf.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: A dad has an uncomfortable talk with his daughter about the birds and the bees, the origin of bagpipes is revealed, and the Robot Chicken writers let the Robot Chicken Nerd take a trip into The Game of Thrones.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: No one knows what disease Gerry injected himself with in World War Z... until the Robot Chicken writers take a crack at it! See Benjamin Franklin's greatest invention, Hannah from Girls gets a new boyfriend and we see the prequel to The Parent Trap.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Our writers unearth The Cryptkeeper to bring you three tales of terror that will haunt you for the rest of your life, the Iron Sheik makes an appearance, the Robot Chicken crew tries to come up with a Candy Crush movie, and Woody Woodpecker gets an unwanted phone call.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The RC gang thought the drift in Pacific Rim could use a little reworking, the future is revealed to kinda suck for Looney Tunes characters in Looper, Voltron gets a new number, and Skeletor takes a trip back through time to rid himself of He-Man once and for all.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Our writers imagine how Scrooge McDuck would do on Shark Tank, Fred Flintstone gets a colonoscopy, Shrek has a moment of clarity, and Doc from Mike Tyson's Punchout passes on to the great arena in the sky.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The zany writers of the show put Master Chief and Cortana in an uncomfortable conversation, Drones are put into action on the G.I. Joe team, we see a few more animal totems from the Visionaries cartoon, and the little Lego folks take on some scary stuff in World War B.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The Robot Chicken crew lets you know if Santa Claus is a racist, Tiger Woods gets his own Space Jam type of movie and we find out what The Bratz girls did last summer.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Have you heard of the Boglins? The RC writers have. And they make a splash with a swamp song, we see what it's like to live the exciting life of a Lemming, Sleeping Beauty has a dream...and no one cares, and a forbidden love blossoms between Shredder and April O'Neil.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Man-E-Faces gets a shot at stardom from the minds behind Robot Chicken, the Starcom boys show NASA how it's done, we get a look at what goes on behind the scenes of Medieval Times when the costumes come off, and the consequences of wishing on a Zoltar machine.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The Robot Chicken writers expose the real reason why no one plays the piano in Wayne Manor. We find out what James Potter and his friends did while in animal form, and the Disney Princesses get into a little scuffle.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The RC dreamers send Kim Possible on a mission to North Korea, worthless Beanie Babies end up turning a man's life around, and the Robot Chicken Nerd has his greatest adventure yet...with Doctor Who!

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: From the minds of the writers, we watch as The Count from Sesame Street has a run-in with Blade, we see that McDonald's isn't just a place for eating, Jor-El has some very helpful advice for Superman, and a new nemesis comes to Gotham City.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.sub-title: Robot Chicken Bitch Pudding Special, The
programme.desc: Robot Chicken fan-favorite character Bitch Pudding gets her time to shine in a brand new solo special! When her fellow citizens in Pastryville get tired of suffering Bitch Pudding's abuse, they hatch a plot to eliminate her once and for all! Now Bitch Pudding will blaze a trail of raging revenge, and the world better learn how to duck and cover!

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: From the minds of the writers, we see how Bear Grylls deal with some Wild Things, Dr. Ryan Stone calls a radio station, Brainy Smurf manipulates events in House of Smurfs, and Baloo discovers he hasn't always just been a bear in the jungle.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The Creators of Robot Chicken wonder what happens when Dumbledore breaks bad, we get to see the kinds of movies Walt Disney really wanted to make, where sheep go when people are done counting them, and G.I. Joe Extreme!

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The Robot Chicken writers imagine where the Velociraptors from Jurassic Park learned to be so clever, our friends from Duck Dynasty take a trip to Duckberg, and as the season comes to an end, will we see the cancellation of Robot Chicken...again?

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.sub-title: Robot Chicken Lots of Holidays Special, The

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Hollywood's so bad it's good when Godzilla fights Jason. How does Bob the Builder deal with competition from Handy Manny? Dinosaur Train's an improbable train! The Little Match girl finds a new, deadly use for her matches.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The Robot Chicken writers find out what happens when the girl from "The Ring" realizes videotape is a dead technology. Fonzie's coolness goes too far on an un-happy day. The Robot Chicken Nerd gets lost in The CW.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.sub-title: Zeb and Kevin Erotic Hot Tub Canvas
programme.desc: How far will Pluto go to get away from his Dwarf Planet friends? There isn't an American Girl doll for everybody. Just like the creators of Robot Chicken have done in the past, The Wild Thornberrys have to get extremely wild to stay on the air.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The Robot Chicken writers - and the Gargoyles - meet their ultimate foe: Pigeons. Naked Captain Picard wins it all! Can the Paw Patrol rescue themselves from the ultimate terror? The Animaniacs get sex-educational.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Take a trip with the Robot Chicken team when the Magic School Bus goes on its final adventure! The circle of life sends the Wonder Pets through a loop! Teenage Archie Andrews finally picks a girlfriend…to smash.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The RC writers wonder whose job was it to walk King Kong. Michael Bay reveals the secrets to Transformers 5. Uncle Pennybags has a monopoly on S&M. Bitch Pudding improves a classic.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.sub-title: Robot Chicken Christmas Special: X-Mas United, The
programme.desc: The minds behind Robot Chicken expose a deep dark family secret, and we learn that nothing will ever be the same when the Robot Chicken Nerd discovers his true father is…Father Christmas! And then a lot of people die.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: From the geniuses in the Robot Chicken writers room, we bring you - uh oh, Skipper, that is not Barbie's bus. The Purge is on, and the unbreakable laws are broken! The battle of the Ex X's? Is it The Predator or The Bachelor…or both?

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Only the RC writers know the true history of the brown M&M. What happened after Charlie won the Chocolate Factory? Can a perverted unicorn make a kid's dream come true? Maybe he shouldn't…

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Robot Chicken introduces the next animated mega-hit: The Cheese League! Oprah lands a hot guest: C'thulhu. Galactus needs a new herald. Family Double Dare breaks a few families apart, and Nickelodeon's Guts teaches a boy to score.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Overheard in the Robot Chicken writers room: the Green Mile seems a lot longer than that. Optimus Prime never shirks his duty...except maybe jury duty. The Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles learn about the birds and the cloacas.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The ingenious Robot Chicken writers give some advice on why you should butt out of the Power Rangers' business. Obi-Wan takes the low road to the high ground. The Terminator goes back in time to stop Eve from eating the apple.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.sub-title: Triple Hot Dog Sandwich on Wheat
programme.desc: The Property Brothers try to satisfy Lex Luthor's need for real estate. Is being a My Little Pony just a phase? The US Army finds a use for Inspector Gadget. Robot Chicken re-tells the story of Goldilocks and the Three Bears.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The RC crew sees Daredevil wasn't the only one to lose his senses in an accident. Hogwarts doesn't teach birth control. Solid Snake gives away his position in the bathroom. The Micronauts get the greatest or worst public transportation system.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: RC explains why Superman wishes he'd locked the door of the Fortress of Solitude. The Robot Chicken Nerd dies or has sex or neither? You are probably smarter than a fifth grader. The Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles get surplus military hardware.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: From the minds of the writers, we watch as Liam Neeson finds his seat in the movies has been…taken. A veterinarian explains how 101 dalmatians reproduce. Monster High steals the Crypt Keeper's schtick.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The RC writers uncover the outtakes from Seth Green's classic Burger King commerical. Krang lies on his online dating profile. Andy's latest toy doesn't fit in with the Toy Story gang. Huey Lewis' lost "Back to the Future" hit song.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The mic has been dropped by those hardcore Robot Chicken writers…but Walter White Jr. picks it up. The Exo-Squad's suits are ready for job #1, but not job #2. Remy makes a new kind of ratatouille.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The writers of Robot Chicken imagine what would happen if Darth Vader learned to say "I'm Sorry." Bugs Bunny takes his cross-dressing to the next level. The Terminator changes the future a bit too much. Edna Mode gets an incredible new job.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.sub-title: Angelic Sounds of Mike Giggling, The
programme.desc: Lois Lane is dead, but was it…super murder? Batman asks if Superman can bleed, but maybe he could care less. You vote on the season 8 finale spectacular!

programme.sub-title: Freshly Baked: The Robot Chicken Santa Claus Pot Cookie Freakout Special: Special Edition
programme.desc: Happy holidays everyone, as Robot Chicken joins Santa for the one Christmas he'll never forget. The north pole elves dream of the toys of holidays past. Krampus puts in a good word for the coal industry. St. Nick meets his idol: Jared Leto.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The Robot Chicken writers are back at work on a new season, but had to take Fury Road to get to the office! Also, Beavis has moved on from his life with Butthead, and Robot Chicken's Nerd is the latest guest in Westworld.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.sub-title: Things Look Bad for the Streepster
programme.desc: Daniel Tiger is taught the toughest lesson of all, thanks to Robot Chicken! A Nerd looks behind the curtain at Nick's Arcade and hates it. Jabberjaw goes on a much-needed vacation... to Amity Island.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The Robot Chicken team discovers the emotions of adulthood in Inside Out 2. The pig from Black Mirror tells all to Howard Stern. The Nerd forces his way through Star Wars: Force Awakens.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Robot Chicken joins the dinosaur revolution as Fred Flintstone runs for his life! Sebastian has union trouble with his orchestra. The MCU holds an intervention for Jessica Jones.

programme.desc: Robot Chicken's writers can't get a grasp of Fight Club's rules. Was old Rose's Titanic flashback just a tall tale? Zack Morris takes a time out with the Avengers.

programme.desc: Robot Chicken wants to show you the monster in its pocket. Megatron goes too far in Beast Wars. Wile E Coyote sees if he can Get Away With Murder!

programme.desc: The Robot Chicken crew witness the straw that breaks Captain Planet's back. A Spider-Man secret is revealed thanks to J. Jonah Jameson. The Nerd realizes his problems are Legion.
